geopolitics_summary: Trump diesel export ban threat dominates EU supply risk; Commission signals demand-side intervention as global supply tightens.

themes.headline: EU Commission urges member states to cut energy demand amid supply constraints
themes.why_it_matters: Demand destruction signal from Brussels suggests structural tightness in EU gas/power markets. Policy-driven load shedding would depress DA/Cal+1 power spreads and TTF forward curves; risk of emergency measures if supply stress persists.

themes.headline: Trump threatens US diesel export ban; EU imports over half from America
themes.why_it_matters: US supplies >50% of EU diesel. Ban would force EU to substitute fuel oil/gas for power generation, lifting gas demand and TTF spot/Cal+1. Direct fuel-switch mechanic into EU power stack; acute risk if 90-day ban materializes.

themes.headline: US LNG push into Balkans risks EU climate goals and gas dependency
themes.why_it_matters: US-backed LNG infrastructure in EU candidate states could lock in long-term gas demand, complicating EU decarbonization and affecting regional hub pricing (e.g., TTF arb spreads to Balkans). Indirect TTF/EUA correlation via policy uncertainty.

themes.headline: UK diesel imports at risk; Trump ban would disrupt one-sixth of UK supply
themes.why_it_matters: Post-Brexit UK energy security exposed to US export policy. Diesel scarcity forces UK power plants to substitute gas; spillover into NW European hub pricing (TTF/UK virtual) via interconnector rebalancing and fuel arbitrage.

themes.headline: Henry Hub summer gas prices 6% below prior year despite high cooling demand
themes.why_it_matters: Weak US gas pricing narrative suggests ample North American supply; reduces LNG export incentive from US to Europe, capping upside pressure on TTF. Inverse of TTF — lower Henry Hub may ease European LNG arb spreads in Q4.

watchlist: Trump diesel export ban 90-day timeline — confirm effective date and scope.
EU Commission demand-reduction mandate rollout — watch for emergency gas/power rationing decrees.
UK-US bilateral energy negotiations post-Starmer Brexit reset speech (Sept 30 or later).
US LNG FID delays or cancellations; monitor Henry Hub weakness signal.
